opening.argument: The video presents BitClub founder pools as a passive-income mining investment, beginning with a $3,500 purchase and reporting that “in nine months this account gave us six thousand two hundred twelve dollars.” The title reinforces that framing by calling the account “passive income,” while the description identifies the video as BitClub marketing and urges viewers to join a team. The offer also uses a level and partner structure: the displayed interface shows a “LEVEL-UP BONUS STRUCTURE” with Team 1 payments, and the speaker associates higher levels with potentially much greater income. This is promotional participation built around mining returns and attracting partners, rather than neutral reporting or criticism.
